aliases: gene array analysis of whole-blood and VaxDesign samples
gene array.sample_type: whole blood RNA; DC/CD4+ T cell co-culture RNA (VaxDesign/MIMIC samples)
gene array.readouts: gene expression changes, differentially expressed genes, transcriptional nodes/signatures

evidence_location.quote: Expression profiles of 594 genes ... were found to change significantly between day 0 and any time point after vaccination.

qPCR.sample_type: whole blood RNA from vaccinated volunteers
qPCR.readouts: expression levels of selected genes for validation of microarray findings

evidence_location.quote: we could observe a highly significant correlation between the results obtained by qPCR and those obtained by gene microarray, with coefficients of correlation ranging between 0.78 and 0.96

ELISA.sample_type: supernatants from monocyte-derived DCs incubated with live, UV-inactivated, or heat-inactivated YF17D

evidence_location.quote: The results show that DCs incubated with live or UV-inactivated YF17D showed a marked increased IL-1β secretion (up to ninefold, compared with DCs incubated in medium alone)

flow cytometry.readouts: frequencies of Ki67+ proliferating leukocyte subsets; antigen-specific CD4+ T cells expressing CD154, IL-2, IFN-γ, IL-5, IL-13; Th1/Th2 phenotype

evidence_location.quote: An increase in frequencies of Ki67 + cells in the CD4 + CD8 − (2.3-fold increase; P = 0.0049) and the CD4 − CD8 + (4.7-fold increase; P = 0.0157) populations occurred within the first 14 d after YF17D vaccination

CFSE labeling.sample_type: PBMCs sampled after vaccination and stimulated with YF17D-derived peptide pools
CFSE labeling.readouts: CD4+ and CD8+ T cell proliferative responses to peptide pools

evidence_location.quote: Both the CD4 + and CD8 + T cell proliferative responses were highly variable among the vaccinated volunteers.

cytometric bead assay (CBA).sample_type: PBMC culture supernatants after stimulation with YF17D-derived peptide pools
cytometric bead assay (CBA).readouts: secreted cytokine levels including IL-2, IFN-γ, TNF, IL-4, and IL-10

evidence_location.quote: In most volunteers (12 out of 15), both Th1 and Th2 cytokine secretion profiles were induced by YF17D peptide pools.

multiplex cytokine analysis.readouts: levels of IL-2, IFN-γ, IL-13, IL-5, IL-10 and other cytokines

evidence_location.quote: When YF17D was used as pulse and recall antigen, the cells produced high levels of all the cytokines measured except IL-10, compared with co-cultures with no recall antigen.
